What is Together Link and which coding agents does it support?

Together Link is a Together AI product that connects coding agent harnesses to open models instead of closed ones, cutting model spend by over 50% while keeping the same workflow. It supports Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex (ChatGPT app and CLI), OpenCode, and Pi, and setup requires one command plus a Together AI API key; reverting to native closed models also takes one command. # Together Link: open models in the harness you already use. Start with one command today.

Together Link lets engineering teams swap the underlying model in coding agents they already use—Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi—for open models like Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, cutting model spend by over 50% while keeping the same workflow. A one-command setup connects the agent to Together AI, an 'Auto' router picks the right model per session (routing once so prompt caching still works), and a per-session tracker shows savings versus Opus 5.5. Billing runs through an existing Together API key with no separate contract required.

Summary [...] ## Getting started

```
curl -fsSL  | bash
```

1. Run one command to set up Together Link: Your agent opens exactly as before, now connected to Together AI with your Together AI API key. Create an account for an API key.
2. Use “Auto” to pick a model with the Together AI Router: It reads each session's first task and sends it to the right model: quick fixes go to fast, low-cost models, and hard problems get frontier capability. If you bring an Anthropic key, it routes between Opus 5.5 and GLM 5.3. Without one, it routes between GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash. Routing happens once per session, so prompt caching keeps working.
3. See your savings after each session. A per-session tracker shows what you spent next to what the same session would have cost on Opus 5.5.
